title: Chicken Parmesan Texas Toast
steps: Prep. Preheat the oven per the Texas toast packaging. Cook the chicken tenders in the air fryer per the packet, then cut into smaller pieces.
Toast. Lay the Texas toast in a 13x9 pan and bake 6 minutes.
Make a bowl. Press down the middle of each toast without going all the way through.
Layer. Mozzarella, then marinara sprinkled with Italian seasoning and crushed red pepper, then the chicken, then more marinara and mozzarella.
Bake. Bake another 5 minutes until the cheese melts; broil on low 2–3 minutes for extra crisp.
notes: Recipe fetched from the creator's linked page: theeverydaycookbook.com/chicken-parmesan-texas-toast
